description: This file defines classes related to text stream termination and processing, including terminator strategies and a templated StreamTextType class for handling text streams with customizable terminators. It includes classes for null, carriage return, and line feed terminators, as well as a complex template class for managing text input/output with synchronization and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: StreamTextType
classes.description: Template class for managing text streams with customizable terminators, including nested handler class for source management and callback mechanisms.

methods.name: IsTerminated
methods.description: Determines if a character indicates termination based on the terminator type.

methods.name: SizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of the terminator sequence.

methods.name: Marker
methods.description: Returns the string marker for the terminator sequence.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data from the internal queue, including terminator markers.

methods.name: ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes incoming data, detects terminators, and triggers callbacks.

methods.name: IsOpen
methods.description: Checks if the channel is open.

methods.name: IsClosed
methods.description: Checks if the channel is closed.

methods.name: IsSuspended
methods.description: Checks if the channel is suspended.

methods.name: LocalId
methods.description: Returns the local identifier of the channel.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to check connectivity.
